title: fix(spec,i18n): an object's embedded listViews are served translated from the _views keys the extractor writes (#21006)
body:
Fixes #21006

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`translateObject` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) now translates each view in an object document's embedded `listViews`. It overlays the view's `label`, its `description` and its `bulkActionDefs[]` copy (def `label` / `confirmText` / `confirmLabel`, param `label` / `help` / `placeholder`). These are the same strings `translateView` overlays on a served view document.

- **One key shape.** The address is `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW.*`, where VIEW is the record key under `listViews`. `os i18n extract` writes exactly that: its `obj.listViews` loop hands `pushViewEntries` the record key (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`). The record key is already bare, so `viewTranslationKey`, which strips a served view's `OBJECT.` prefix, is not involved, and the view's own optional `name` is never read. `resolveViewLabel` / `resolveViewDescription` and the embedded channel now share one private lookup (`lookupViewText`) of `_views.VIEW.label` / `.description`. No second key function exists.
- **Bulk-action copy** goes through the existing `translateBulkActionDefs`, reading `view.bulkActionDefs`. That is the authored address the extractor reads. A served view document nests the same list under `config`, and `translateView` keeps reading it there.
- **Override order** follows ADR-0029 D9.2a, as `translateView` applies it (the rule from #20680 / #20730). Each string is judged by the existing `valueOverridesPackagedBase` against the same view in the packaged object's `listViews`. That packaged object is the `packagedBase` the REST read gate already supplies for objects (`getPackagedObjectBase`). A view the packaged base does not carry counts as authored. With no base supplied, the catalog applies.
- **Not changed:** `emptyState` is not translated server-side on either channel. `translateView` never translated it, and the extractor's docblock names the client as its only reader.
- `ObjectLike` gains an optional `listViews` member, typed as a string-keyed `Record` of `unknown`. It is a TS-only input shape: no export is added and no generated artefact moves. The only code that builds an `ObjectLike` in this repo (service-analytics' `{ name, fields }`) still type-checks. The reverse verification is below.

The change lands where the claim said it would. `translateObject` produces the served labels, and the extractor is untouched.

## Measured

**H1, the key shape.** An embedded `listViews` entry is an `ObjectListViewSchema` (`data/object.zod.ts`). Its copy-bearing keys that the extractor emits under `_views.VIEW` are `label`, `description`, `emptyState.title` / `.message` and `bulkActionDefs[].*`. All of them sit under the key shape the resolver already reads. Nothing needed a new key.

**H2, the override order.** `translateView` and `translateDashboard` both judge with `valueOverridesPackagedBase` against `packagedBase` (#20731 / #20680). The embedded channel uses the same predicate and the same three edges: no base means the catalog applies, a non-string label is never an override, and an edit back to the shipped string is a no-op.

**H3, the door.** `GET /api/v1/meta/object` goes `meta-item-read-gate.ts` `translateMetaDocument` / `translateMetaList`, then `translateMetadataDocument('object')`, then `translateObject`, with `packagedBase` from `getPackagedObjectBase`. `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` names `translateObject` only in a docblock and does not call it. I measured the door once through the REST route handlers. The protocol double served the REAL `SysAccount` (`@objectstack/platform-objects/identity`), `getPackagedObjectBase` answered the same object, and the i18n service served the REAL shipped `en` / `zhCN` bundles (`@objectstack/platform-objects/apps`). It ran as a scratch test that is not committed.

| read (zh-CN unless noted) | before (spec dist at `2f2fa11d7`) | after (spec dist at this branch) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| item `label` (object) | `身份链接` | `身份链接` |
| item `listViews.mine.label` | `My Links` | `我的链接` |
| item `listViews.by_provider.label` | `By Provider` | `按提供方` |
| list `listViews.mine.label` | `My Links` | `我的链接` |
| org overlay `mine` = `My Links (edited-21006)`, item | `My Links (edited-21006)` | `My Links (edited-21006)` (the overlay wins) |
| same overlay, sibling `by_provider` | `By Provider` | `按提供方` |
| `en`, item `listViews.mine.label` | `My Links` | `My Links` |

The CLI's coverage still counts the same keys. `i18n-coverage` takes its key set from the extractor's `collectExpectedEntries`, which this PR does not touch. `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` exited 0 and the CLI's i18n unit tests passed (below), so extract and serve now agree.

## Tests

New file `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.object-list-views.test.ts`, 21 cases. The `sys_account` fixture is transcribed from `identity/sys-account.object.ts`, with its `_views` leaves taken verbatim from the shipped `en` / `zh-CN` bundles. Every view is parsed by `ObjectListViewSchema` and the bundle by `TranslationBundleSchema`.

- `sys_account`'s `mine` tab is served `我的链接` in zh-CN, and every sibling tab is translated too.
- **Controls:** a view with no catalog entry keeps its authored label; an object with no `_views` gets the same `listViews` reference back; no bundle gets the same reference back; an object with no `listViews` gains none.
- The view is keyed by its record key, never by its `name`. BCP-47 base-language matching applies, and a default-locale request does not walk the fallback chain.
- `description` and bulk-action copy are translated from the embedded view's own address.
- **Override order:** an edited label wins in zh-CN and `en`, each tab is judged separately, no base means the catalog applies, a reset restores the translation, and the edge cases hold (edit back to the shipped string, inline map). A tab the base does not ship keeps its label. The object-scalar rule and the tab rule are independent.
- Neither input is mutated, and `translateMetadataDocument('object')` reaches the change.

**Reverse verification.** The fix was committed first. Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which reported the anchor hit, the blob moved, and then restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Leg 1: replace the `translateObjectListViews(...)` call with `doc.listViews`. Result: **15 failed / 6 passed** of 21. The 6 that passed are the controls and the edited-wins cases, which pass when nothing is translated.
- Leg 2: replace the per-view `valueOverridesPackagedBase(...)` with `false`. Result: **5 failed / 16 passed**. All 5 failures are override cases.
- Cross-package type: inject `listViews: 5` into service-analytics' `ObjectLike` literal. `tsc` answered `src/plugin.ts(1056,61): error TS2322`, saying type `number` is not assignable to the string-keyed `Record` of `unknown`. That is the rebuilt `.d.ts`; the old one would have answered an excess-property error. Restored.

## Local verification (HEAD `402ab32f5`)

The spec closure (①) is empty, because `packages/spec` has no workspace dependencies. Consumer closures were built with `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/rest^...'` and with the `@objectstack/cli^...` / `@objectstack/plugin-approvals^...` packages that were not built yet.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` → 0. `check:generated` → `✓ All 15 generated artifacts are up to date`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` → 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`). `vitest run src/system` → 49 files / 1720 passed.
- Consumers, one reading per package:
  - `@objectstack/rest`, the five `meta-*i18n*` tests: 5 files / 96 passed.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, full suite: 195 passed / 3 skipped files, 2896 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/cli`, `--project unit` `test/i18n-` + `test/platform-page-i18n-parity`: 22 files / 292 passed. The integration tier is declared to CI.
  - `@objectstack/service-analytics`, full suite: 150 files / 3458 passed. Its `typecheck` → 0.
  - `@objectstack/platform-objects`, full suite: 59 files / 948 passed.
  - `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `src/translations`: 3 files / 11 passed.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` over this diff (84 families) plus `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity`: 83 of 84 ran and exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) and exited 0 after the missing packages were built. `--ran` reconciliation: 84 derived, 83 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 1 UNRUN.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:type-check-debt`. Reason: `--re-measure` runs tsc over the whole workspace and was killed twice at the 570 s foreground budget; it has no narrowing option. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` owns it. The type-check this diff owes was measured: spec and service-analytics `typecheck` both 0.
- **Lint, a measured narrowing.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the two changed TS files: 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Both files are in the population, by `eslint --print-config`. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` run belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The extractor's `pushViewEntries` docblock (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`) names `translateView` as the server-side reader of `_views.VIEW.label` / `.description`. After this PR, `translateObject` is a second server-side reader, for the object-nested channel. The docblock lags in a file outside this card's surface. Noted, not filed.
- `_views.VIEW.emptyState.*` is still read client-side only, on both channels. That is unchanged and is stated as design in the extractor's docblock.
- This branch is based on `2f2fa11d7` and was not merged with `main` before opening. `origin/main` is 21 commits ahead. None of those commits touches `i18n-resolver.ts`, its tests, the REST meta read gate, the extractor or the platform catalogs. Their `ui/view.zod.ts` change is docblock-only, and their `rest-server.ts` change is outside the translation path. PR CI runs on the merge ref.

## objectui follow-up (not in this PR)

objectui's `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useServedViewItems.ts` documents the `/meta/object`-embedded views as untranslated by the server. Once this lands, `isServedView` should also answer true for a view id that is a key of the served `/meta/object` document's `listViews`, read from the pre-merge `useMetadata().getItemsByType('object')`. Then `viewTabLabel` (`ObjectView.tsx`) and the `AppHeader` crumb draw those labels as given instead of a second `viewLabel` pass, in which the bundle would win an edit back. The seat files that child after this lands.
